proposal.blind_spot: With high occupancy but low issue rates, the optimizer cannot tell whether resident warps are stalled on global-memory load dependencies or on block-reduction barriers, so it always guesses memory latency and sometimes makes barrier-bound reductions slower.

rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard: HIGH -> warps wait on global loads: vectorize/widen loads, more elements per thread for loads in flight, prefetch earlier, fix coalescing / LOW -> memory latency is not the stall: stop adding ILP and restructure synchronization or launch geometry instead
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_barrier_per_war: HIGH -> block-wide tl.sum/tl.max barriers dominate: shrink programs to one warp for warp-shuffle reductions, give each program multiple rows to amortize barriers, or use a two-phase reduction / LOW -> barriers are cheap: multi-warp blocks are safe, focus on memory-access structure or grid parallelism
